biomarkers.name: TP53, RB1, ATRX
biomarkers.clinical_use: Common alterations in leiomyosarcoma; ATRX loss associates with ALT (alternative lengthening of telomeres)

biomarkers.name: ER, PR (uterine LMS)
biomarkers.clinical_use: AI (letrozole) has activity in ER+ uterine LMS

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Fascicles of eosinophilic spindle cells with blunt-ended (cigar-shaped) nuclei; smooth muscle differentiation
histomorphological_subtype.grading: FNCLCC (French Federation) grading based on differentiation, mitoses, necrosis

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Typically immune-cold; sparse TILs; IO responses generally poor
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Fascicular smooth muscle architecture; areas of necrosis in high-grade tumours

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Smooth muscle cells (or their mesenchymal precursors) — at multiple anatomic sites
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Smooth muscle differentiation (desmin+, SMA+, h-caldesmon+, calponin+) with fascicular architecture of eosinophilic spindle cells with cigar-shaped nuclei
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Distinct anatomic sites (uterine, retroperitoneal, soft tissue, cutaneous, vascular) have distinct molecular biology despite shared smooth muscle differentiation; retroperitoneal often shows RB1/TP53 co-loss
